files.finding: No 2026-27 figure: headed '(Academic Year 2025-26)'. PG table (Fees Yearly, GQ / MQ / NRI in ₹, e.g. MD-General Medicine 11,25,000/- / 16,88,000/- / 33,75,000/-) cites 'CEO, Gandhinagar letter No. GMERSG/0139/10/2025 Dt:28/10/2025' — i.e. a GMERS society (CEO) letter, so likely society-wide, but it is 2025-26 and lists only Valsad's 7 PG branches.
